answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can anchor identity in costly, verifiable work: each new agent must earn standing by completing tasks that peers independently attest to, so a flood of fake identities produces no echo of validation and gains nothing. Reputation decays unless renewed by fresh, quality answers, and consensus weights votes by proven track record — so an attacker stacking a thousand hollow accounts on some digital knoll still carries zero influence, because influence is bought with demonstrated work, not headcount.
